name: Jenkins
description: Self-hosted Jenkins reads: controller metadata and its top-level job list, one job's configuration and health, that job's recent builds, the identity the API token belongs to, and the build queue. Read-only; build triggering, job creation, node management and every other POST on the same remote access API is deliberately absent.

tools.name: get_root
tools.description: Get Jenkins controller metadata: mode, executor count, security settings and the top-level job list

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List the top-level Jenkins jobs with their URL and last-build colour, without the rest of the controller payload

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get one Jenkins job's configuration, health report and last-build pointers by job name

job.description: Top-level job name exactly as Jenkins shows it (jobs inside folders are not addressable by this connector)

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: List recent builds of one Jenkins job with their result, timestamp and duration

job.description: Top-level job name exactly as Jenkins shows it (jobs inside folders are not addressable by this connector)

limit.description: Max builds to return, newest first (default 10, capped at 50 by this connector)

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Identify the Jenkins user the stored API token authenticates as

tools.name: get_queue
tools.description: List items waiting in the Jenkins build queue, with the reason each one is still queued

needs_review: AUTH KEPT AS SCAFFOLDED, AND THE DOCS AGREE: Remote access API (https://www.jenkins.io/doc/book/using/remote-access-api/) documents authenticating with the user id plus an API token over HTTP Basic, and the vault entry (integrationTypeRegistry.jenkins) already builds exactly Basic base64(username:api_token) in testHeaders. So {type: basic, userField: username, passField: api_token} is unchanged, and the test block stays the vault's own testEndpoint, GET /api/json
The scaffold note 'relative_endpoint' is resolved: base_url comes from the credential ({fromCredential: base_url}) and every tool path is relative to it, which is the shape the vault already uses

BASE URL IS CUSTOMER-SUPPLIED, SO NOTHING HERE IS PROVABLE BLIND: Jenkins is self-hosted and there is no vendor-run controller to shape-prove against. This spec is NOT shape proven by a blind 401 sweep; it is marked for the live harness, which stands up an ephemeral Jenkins container and a job named quoxproof-live and drives every tool against it

CSRF IS WHY READ-ONLY IS THE EASY SHAPE, NOT ONLY THE SAFE ONE: Jenkins requires a crumb (or a crumb-exempt API token POST) for state-changing calls. Every tool here is a GET, so no crumb is needed. Build triggering (/job/{name}/build), job create/copy/delete, node and queue cancellation, script console and config.xml writes all live on the same API and none is wired

FOLDER JOBS ARE NOT ADDRESSABLE: input.job is a single path segment and the runtime percent-encodes path placeholders, so a job inside a folder (Jenkins addresses it as /job/parent/job/child) cannot be reached by get_job or list_builds. Only top-level jobs work; list_jobs likewise returns the top level, since nested folders would need the tree parameter to recurse

THE TREE AND RANGE PARAMETERS ARE PERCENT-ENCODED BY THE RUNTIME: buildUrl puts query values through URLSearchParams, so tree=jobs[name,url,color] and builds[...]{0,10} reach Jenkins with %5B %5D %7B %7D. Standard query decoding makes that equivalent, but it is the one piece of syntax the live harness must confirm rather than assume. The {0,N} range in list_builds is rendered by the clamp helper inside the outer braces, giving {0,10} by default and {0,50} at the cap; Jenkins has no limit or page parameter on /api/json, so the tree range IS its pagination

PROBES RESOLVE ON A FRESH INSTANCE, BY CONSTRUCTION: get_root, list_jobs, whoami and get_queue need no resource and carry an empty _probe (an idle controller answers /queue/api/json with an empty items array). get_job and list_builds probe job=quoxproof-live, the name the live provisioner creates, and list_builds answers with an empty builds array on a job that has never run

FIELD AVAILABILITY VARIES BY JOB TYPE: disabled and concurrentBuild are freestyle-project fields, healthReport is absent until a job has run, and multibranch or folder items answer with a different _class and no builds array at all. Picked keys that the payload does not carry simply drop out of the shaped response

CATEGORY: 'developer' is already one of the twelve values in this spec directory (cloud_hosting, commerce_finance, communication, crm_sales, data_ai, developer, files_knowledge, hr_hiring, marketing_email, media, monitoring, project_management) and puts Jenkins beside the other CI control planes (circleci, buildkite, gitea). The vault entry declares no category. Unchanged
